title: backends sharing one store: an order with a required and an optional value object and a contained part, cached by id — the fixture the multi-backend harness copies onto one database and one redis

mikroorm.reason: the MikroORM adapter syncs only its own entities at boot and has no migration chain, so the generator refuses it on a database another backend migrates

dapper.reason: the Dapper adapter folds a value object into one jsonb column instead of the flattened leaf columns of the shared schema, so the generator refuses it on a database another backend migrates
